scope: Author-head evaluation through the independent anomalib implementation; auxiliary training is not reproduced.

reference_protocol.selection: CPU torch.randint with replacement, reseeded independently for every category and shot/seed pair.
reference_protocol.pool: Normal target training images only; sorted MVTec filenames and original VisA 1cls.csv row order.

evaluation_protocol.mask_resize: Binarize original mask, nearest resize to input size and then 256 square
evaluation_protocol.supplemental_precision: CLIP FP16 projections/features and FP32 LayerNorm/head; input-dtype torchvision Gaussian kernel
evaluation_protocol.auroc: Exact Torchmetrics binary AUROC on CUDA
evaluation_protocol.paper_ap: Exact Torchmetrics precision-recall curve followed by recall-sorted trapezoidal area, auc(reorder=True)
evaluation_protocol.standard_ap: Stepwise average precision, retained in separately named CSV columns
evaluation_protocol.aggregation: Category macro mean per seed, then mean and population standard deviation across seeds

metric_definition_audit.finding: The released evaluator calls its recall-sorted trapezoidal PR area AP. This differs from standard average precision, including on perfect rankings and tied predictions.
metric_definition_audit.initial_measurements: Initial standard-AP evaluations were preserved locally under initial_average_precision and excluded from the final paper comparison.
metric_definition_audit.core_metric_policy: Anomalib's standard AUPR implementation is unchanged.

author_declared_environment.qualification: These are released requirements, not a certified original paper-run environment.

remaining_limitations: Frozen encoders use timm rather than the author's vendored implementations.
Installed software versions differ from the released author requirements and are recorded per run.
Original unpublished paper reference manifests and stagewise numerical fixtures are unavailable.
Paper uncertainty is not equated to the explicitly reported population standard deviation.
The exact-byte uint8 resize and VisA reference ordering belong to the reproduction helper; generic Engine datamodule preprocessing alone is not claimed to reproduce them.
licensing: Authorized research/evaluation access does not resolve source licensing. No author weights, raw data or exported model binaries are redistributed.
quantization: Activation PTQ/ACQ debugging remains deferred. Historical legacy quantization measurements are not certification of the new author graph.
